title: De La Fratta
visualBrief: Standing Cesta/De La Fratta fortress: mapped irregular lower stone enclosure/occupied court, sparse recessed grilled windows and real recessed arched closed gate/short approach treads. Tall pentagonal keep, projected rounded machicolation mouths/corbel piers, crenellated upper crown and small tile-roofed top cabin. Two low map-associated roofed wings, restrained chimney/slits/roof edging, locally bounded faceted limestone outcrop contacting unchanged coarse DEM. Original shared-material geometry and four browser levels. No copied stone-crack/coat-of-arms atlas, museum collection/furnished rooms, temporary visitors/masts/ropes or other independent buildings/whole ridge.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Exact-QID OSMway59329686 is standard PMTiles primary35184431418518; two corresponding parts35185154011759/760 control the northern wing/polygonal end and central square room. Retain anchor12.451359066,43.932622165 and heading0/native east/south vertices. Mapped long-axis internal angle+1.23483791576rad places local+X towardSSE; this is opposite in sign to the engine heading convention. Photographs control the keep/corbel/crown and lower roofed-wing relationship; fine keep footprint across the northern/central mapped parts, side of the lower gate and room allocation remain picture/map approximations, about5m/30degrees. Main mapped enclosure remains26.6x12.6m. Other nearby map buildings are independent, including the unlabelled southern curved footprint; no attribution is invented for them.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: No qualified height is supplied by the retained catalog or vector controls. Picture-led nominal estimates: curtain parapet8.0m/merlons9.15m above occupied court; keep shaft to16.9m, machicolation band to18.3m, upper parapet to19.55m/merlons20.65m; small upper cabin/tile hip reaches22.4m. Roofed lower wings around7.4–9.7m, narrow stack about10.4m. Pentagonal keep allocation within the north map part, window/corbel inventory, roof profile and repair patches remain simplified estimates. The Monte Titano739m point is a separate nearby peak, not this model height/datum.

reconstruction.terrainBasis: Retain original6m standard Mapzen grid/native paths/water and every independent building. Only the three corresponding main castle/part shells are replaced with2cm pad. The court is level above sampled occupied-envelope maxima and nominally1.2m above the native approach endpoint; a narrowly bounded original faceted limestone outcrop extends down to sampled native grade around the castle, with buried contact skirts. It approximates the pictured cliff without changing terrain or claiming a surveyed rock face. Entrance treads follow the short mapped-side approach down to existing grade. No whole-ridge slab, terrain flattening or ground/water cutout. DEM greatly smooths the cliff: absolute court/foundation/rock levels and approach route are visualization fits.
